data.title: 堀京子 · 冬夜被炉里的橘子
data.description: 客厅被炉，她半个身子缩在被炉里剥橘子，头发放下来散在肩上；电视的光映在她脸上，是忙碌一天后难得的懒散时刻。
data.action: 披散头发缩进被炉，悠闲剥开一只橘子。
data.promptProse: Tucked halfway under the thick quilt of the living-room kotatsu on a quiet winter night, Hori wears her chunky oatmeal cable-knit sweater with her chestnut hair falling loose around her shoulders. Leaning comfortably against the low table beside a small dish of winter citrus, she peels a bright mandarin orange with unhurried ease while soft light from an off-frame television flickers gently across her relaxed face and warm living room.
data.animaCaption: Tucked warmly under the winter kotatsu blanket in her oatmeal cable-knit sweater, Hori unhurriedly peels a mandarin orange beside a small plate. Soft television light and warm room shadows soften her relaxed evening expression.
